title: Create: Clean n' Cleanse
description: Renewable Sponges and more, with Create
body:
### Create: Clean n' Cleanse

This mod adds a renewable way to obtain sponges, based on real-life chemistry! Enjoy a thorough recipe chain involving many chemical powders and liquids, processed through Create's machinery.

### Sponge Blocks

Vanilla sponge blocks, now in _five_ colors! Fully integrated with vanilla furnace smelting and Create's basin draining. Can also be used as Potato Cannon ammunition!

### Sponge Items

A handheld way to drain water. Saw up a block to get four of them — they drain one fourth that of a block (obviously) and can also be emptied into an item drain, basin or cauldron!

### Chemical powders and liquids

This mod adds _nine_ powders and _ten_ fluids as part of a complex production chain. Obtain sulfur from crushing soul sand, scoria or sulfur blocks (vanilla backport compat), salt and soda ash from washing kelp ash, process pulp with lye, and more!

Some chemicals will be given more use in the future, so stay tuned!

### Copper oxidizing

New recipes and methods to rapidly oxidize copper. Mix sulfur and processed limestone to create a new compound, 'Lime sulfur', an effective patina agent!
